profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer @ Meta | Reality Labs
profile.summary:
In the Reality Labs at Meta now I work on the Quest Oculus AR/VR headset hardware's OS and backend API. (including Linux C++ ARM on Android platform, Perfetto tracing/profiler)

My core expertise lies in a rare combination of backend + hardware/embedded engineering. Additional experience in the DevOps stack makes this particular skillset even more practical.

As a Staff Software Engineer and Software Engineering Manager at Mentor Graphics, I lead a team of highly-skilled and productive software engineers who build and maintain the Design for Manufacturing and Test Engineering software products for our division. 

I have more than 20 years of professional experience in software development, architecture, and management. Main expertise in C# & C++ (23 years, 2002). Python, Docker, Kubernetes, Git, and Perfetto tracing/profiler.

I am passionate about solving complex problems, learning new technologies, and delivering high-quality software. I have successfully led the conversion of our legacy desktop Windows software into a SaaS cloud product, designed and developed the division's next-generation SaaS cloud platform architecture, and implemented a fully automated Continuous Delivery/Deployment system for our cloud applications. I also perform the roles of Product Owner and SCRUM Master, ensuring that our products meet the needs and expectations of our customers and stakeholders. I am a Certified ScrumMaster (CSM) and a strong advocate of agile methodologies and continuous improvement.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: On the Reality Labs team I am responsible for working on the OS of the hardware Quest AR/VR devices as well as the backend API that serves them.
positions.insights: Skills: Protocol Buffers · REST · Software Development · Embedded Software · Cross-platform Development · Virtual Reality (VR) · Embedded Systems · Perfetto · Embedded Linux · Augmented Reality (AR) · Hardware · Debugging · C++ · Testing · Operating Systems · API Development · Software Design

positions.title: Software Engineering Manager
positions.description:
Built the Test Engineering software team from the ground up to become the most
productive, highly-skilled, and highest output team in our division. Performed
management, team leadership, Product Owner and SCRUM Master roles.
Led conversion of our legacy desktop Windows software into a SaaS cloud product.
Designed and led development of the division's conversion to our next-generation SaaS
cloud platform architecture.
Architect and lead backend developer for REST API and microservice-based backend
system. (C#)
Lead DevOps engineer where I designed, developed, and administrated fully automated
Continuous Delivery/Deployment system for our cloud applications using ArgoCD,
GitLab CI, Docker, and Kubernetes.
Project lead and developer for tool to translate in-house PCB Assembly Work Instruction
Documentation format and embed into PDW CAD design format for input into our
PDW-based sister product. (C#, C++/CLI, C++)
Project lead and developer for creation of REST API cloud backend to allow querying
CAD package details by manufacturer part number (MPN) from our proprietary VPL CAD
package library. (C#)

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed Valor DFT product which analyzed PCB schematic designs to analyze
testability and test coverage, and automatically find optimal solution for test probe
placement on network traces and components. (C++, C++/CLI, C#)

positions.title: Senior Software Design Engineer (III)
positions.description:
Firmware/system software development for test and measurement devices in the Logic
Analyzer and Performance Oscilloscope product lines.
Added support for new Active Interposer DDR4 and DDR5 SDRAM logic analyzer
probes to acquisition probe qualification/characterization custom embedded test fixture
TLACAL. (C)
Led software team and one of four SW architects on a 70 engineer team developing
system software for the successful new product introduction DPOSX70000SX
Performance Oscilloscope, which was the #1 priority program in our company, and which
recognized invoices totalling $125M in the first quarter of launch. (C++, C#)
Developed startup negotiation and system configuration control for UltraSync multi-unit
oscilloscope connection functionality responsible for clock and trigger synchronization,
communication, and high-speed PCIe serial data bus. (C#)
Wrote “Agile Playbook” for initial conversion of our division’s software development
methodology from waterfall to agile/SCRUM.
Developed & maintained test system subscription and usage tracker internal web tool to
relieve pressure due to low amount of available test system prototypes. (Python, Django)
Destination of last resort for highest priority unresolvable defects. (C++, C#)

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer, Mobile Wireless Group
positions.description:
Added support for WiMax cellular broadband functionality to Intel’s existing ZeroConfig
Wifi connection and profile configurator in the Mobile Wireless Group (MWG). (C++)
Implemented replacement for ZeroConfig which abstracted available network device
types (Bluetooth/WiFI/WiMax/PAN) by serving COM objects representing low-level
network devices from ATL Server running in a Windows Service. (C++, C#)
Added support for High DPI resolutions to GUI. (C#)
Resolved highest priority defects.
positions.insights: Skills: .NET · CMake · Requirements Gathering · C# · Requirements Analysis · C++/CLI · C++ · Testing

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer, Client-Side Development
positions.description:
Lead developer for client-side of Poker Mountain online poker site.
Developed GUI client in Win32 API and MFC and web services communication to server
in C++ and C# (.NET Framework 1.0!).

volunteerExperiences.description:
Volunteer Lead Backend Developer and Executive Producer for a team submitting
Sandbox Data Science Analysis Visualization web app to the U.S Census Bureau’s

Backend Developer for opensource datadriven dynamic backend service/REST API/ web application developed on Postgres/python/Django/REST stack.

projects.title: Advanced Memory
projects.description: Next generation, cutting-edge SOTA multi-layered agentic memory/knowledge system. Combines episodic recall with factual based knowledge and grounding via search + RAG. Dynamically-curated via LLM agent. Accessed via a custom MCP server to handle orchestration and present a simplified interface.

projects.title: Advanced Memory
projects.description: Next-generation agent memory persistence combining three separate current state of the art memory technologies into a coherent system orchestrated by an MCP server. (i.e. mem0 + memgraph + RAG-based grounding + mcp server orchestration)
